close_reason: from_credentials now returns Result<Self, CredentialStoreError> instead of panicking; all 17 call sites updated across 9 files; tests pass
description:
In crates/auth/src/store.rs, from_credentials calls bcrypt::hash_with_result (or equivalent) and panics if a stored credential has an invalid hash string. The callers from_file and from_content both return Result<_, ConfigError>, but from_credentials is infallible in its signature and panics instead. Panicking library functions are non-idiomatic in Rust and make the error unrecoverable.

Fix: change from_credentials to return Result<CredentialStore, ConfigError> and propagate the bcrypt parse error. Update the two call sites (from_file, from_content) to use ?.
title: auth: CredentialStore::from_credentials panics on invalid bcrypt hash
